name: Tsukuba Aoi
source: Only heroine not part of the garden club and instead part of student organization. Which leads to tensions because of bad history between them. Is the first girl to be open and friendly to protagonist when he transfers over. Also one of few students who has had some experience with men outside of school. Despite telling protagonist shouldn't be a pervert at times she seems to trust his words more than anyone else at school. Is worried that garden club might be abusing him and using their power/influence on protagonist.
